Thanks for the report.

This looks like the website itself treating Electron differently (for example bot detection or blocking embedded browsers). Electron can't change that; the site's operator is the right contact.

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>
